careers.summary: The build keeps Figma's order (hero, culture strip, open-roles list) but is a visibly different page: 3 emoji cards instead of 4 icon-tile cards, 3 invented roles instead of Figma's 5 placeholder roles, smaller hero type with different copy, no full-bleed roles band, no tag pills and no closing 'reach out' line; it is 169px shorter (1661 vs 1830). The role meta line and eyebrow pill also fail AA, and the Apply links all share one name.

findings.title: Eyebrow pill style (UiBadge) - weight, tracking, padding, fill and ink
findings.figma: Pill 503:140 at x676, 88x27: padding 6/12, radius 999, fill #1e232c (elevated), text 'CAREERS' 12px/700 uppercase, letter-spacing 1.2px, ink #5b6bd6. Note Figma's own ink is 3.39:1 on that fill (below AA 4.5:1).
findings.build: UiBadge variant='featured' size='sm' (CareersView.vue:16): 11px/600, letter-spacing 0.55px (0.05em), padding 4px 8px, height 26.5, fill #201f3a (accent-soft), ink #6e5cf0 = 3.38:1 (fails AA). Same component and same values appear in the hero of every page in this area.
findings.evidence: dom ui-badge variant-featured: fs 11px fw 600 ls 0.55px pad 4px 8px; $RUN/report.json contrast_survey careers 'Join Our Team' 11.0px/600 = 3.38 (required 4.5).
findings.fix: Use the size-md geometry (padding 6px 12px, 12px text) with weight 700 and letter-spacing 0.1em on an elevated (#1c1f28) fill, as Figma. Because Figma's ink also fails AA (3.39:1) and #7e6eff only reaches 4.36:1 on #1c1f28, the ink needs an Uma-approved lighter primary that reaches 4.5:1; do not copy #5b6bd6 across. One fix in src/components/UiBadge.vue serves careers, affiliates, privacy and terms.

Icons are text emoji (globe, rocket, church) at 32px with no tile and no aria-hidden. Titles 18px/700; body 14px/21px. Container max-width 1000 (Figma content width 1248).
findings.evidence: vp_style_diff careers: design-only 'Remote-first', 'Real impact', 'Craft & ownership', 'Rest matters' (17.5x600) and their 14x400 bodies; build-only 'Why Work With Us' (section-title 26px), three icon divs 32px, h3 18px 'Fully Remote & Flexible' / 'High Technical Standards' / 'Impact for the Local Church'. dom culture-card w 301.3 h 237 radius 16px. findings.title: Open roles list: heading, band, row anatomy and button
findings.figma: Band 503:173 full-bleed y729-1472, fill #171b22, pad 44/96/48/96, gap 24. H2 'Open roles' 30px/700 centred (y773). List 940 wide at x250, gap 14. Row 940x95, radius 16, fill #0e1116, 1px #2b323d, padding 20/24, gap 16: title 18px/600; below it three tag pills (department, 'Remote', 'Full-time'/'Part-time'; 12px/500 #9aa4b2 on #1e232c, radius 999, padding 5/10, h25, gap 8); at right a 99x39 'View role' button (radius 10, fill #1e232c, 1px #2b323d, 14px/600). Closing line centred, 640 wide, 15px #9aa4b2: 'Don't see your role? We're always glad to meet thoughtful people - reach out at careers@selahcue.app.'

findings.title: Role meta line fails AA (muted ink on surface)
findings.figma: Department / location / type are drawn as pills with #9aa4b2 text on #1e232c = 6.25:1.
findings.build: src/views/CareersView.vue:82 .role-meta: 13px/400, --sc-text-muted #6b7383 on the row fill #14161d = 3.79:1, on all three rows.

findings.title: Apply links have identical names with no role context
findings.figma: Five 'View role' buttons, identical text, one per row (the same ambiguity exists in Figma).
findings.build: Three links named 'Apply Now →' (CareersView.vue:56). Nothing ties each link to its role title: the title is an h3 sibling in the row div, not an ancestor list item, label or description.
findings.evidence: dom focus list careers: 'Apply Now →' at y888, y997, y1105 (tag a, same accessible name).
findings.fix: Add aria-label="Apply for {role title}" (or aria-describedby pointing at the row's h3 id) to each link. No visual change.

findings.title: Open roles are invented in both Figma and the build (and differ from each other)
findings.figma: Five roles: Senior Rust Engineer (Engineering, Remote, Full-time); Flutter / Mobile Engineer (Engineering, Remote, Full-time); Product Designer (Design, Remote, Full-time); Developer Advocate (Church Tech) (Community, Remote, Full-time); Support Specialist (Support, Remote, Part-time).
findings.build: Three different hard-coded roles (src/views/CareersView.vue:5-9): 'Rust Systems & Graphics Engineer' (Core Engine, 'Remote (US/EU/Africa)', Full-time), 'Senior Vue / Frontend Engineer' (Web & Dashboard), 'Worship Tech Solutions Specialist' (Customer Success). 'Remote (US/EU/Africa)' is an extra geography claim.
findings.evidence: grep -ri 'hiring|job posting|open roles|ATS' over docs/ and implementation/ finds nothing but MARKETING-SITE-HANDOFF (section 1a: 'Roles are illustrative placeholders'; section 8 lists open roles under 'Assumed'). dom role-title x3.
findings.decision: Keep Figma's list layout (careers-04) but ship no role the company has not opened. What does the page say when the list is empty (see careers-09)? Owner to confirm whether any real role exists to list.

findings.title: Company claims and the careers@ mailbox
findings.figma: Hero: 'We're a small, remote team...'. Card 'Remote-first', 'Ship features churches use live, every week.', 'Sustainable pace - we build for the long run.' Footer line: 'reach out at careers@selahcue.app'.
findings.build: 'remote-first team' (hero), 'Fully Remote & Flexible - Work from anywhere in the world with flexible hours built around your life and family', 'Remote (US/EU/Africa)' and the build-only claim 'Your work directly supports thousands of volunteer tech teams and worship leaders every single Sunday.' (CareersView.vue:40). The build has no careers@ line.
findings.evidence: No user, install or customer count exists in the repo (README 'Known gaps': downloads do not exist yet; no installer is served). careers@selahcue.app appears only in Figma; mailboxes in the repo are support@selahcue.app (ContactView.vue:61) and affiliates@selahcue.app (AffiliateHelpView.vue:29); docs/legal/LEGAL-DRAFT-NOTES.md row L-1 says mailboxes must be confirmed real before launch.
findings.decision: Owner: what can we honestly say about team size and remote policy? Remove 'thousands of volunteer tech teams' (no usage data). Does careers@selahcue.app exist (and on which domain: selahcue.app or selahcueapp.com)? Until confirmed, Figma's closing line ships without an address.

findings.title: Role destination and the empty-roles state are not designed
findings.figma: Each row has a 'View role' button but no role-detail frame exists, and no frame shows the page with zero open roles. MARKETING-SITE-HANDOFF section 8 lists 'deeper article/doc/role detail pages' as out of scope.
findings.build: Every row links to /contact via UiButton to="/contact" (CareersView.vue:56) labelled 'Apply Now →'. With careers-07 resolved honestly the list may be empty, and the build has no empty state.
findings.evidence: src/views/CareersView.vue:56; docs/design/MARKETING-SITE-HANDOFF.md section 8 ('Out of scope').
findings.decision: Uma: where does a role link go (role detail page, mailto, external ATS) and what does the Open roles band show when nothing is open ('No open roles right now' plus the 'reach out' line)? Needed before careers-04 and careers-07 can ship.

privacy.summary: The header treatment (centred title, muted centred last-updated line, dark page) follows Figma, but the page is 13,407px against 1,772px because the real legal draft replaced Figma's placeholder prose (class B, ClickUp 17tnw2b0x3g, PR #142). What Figma designs and the build does not match is the title (36/800 vs 44/700), section headings (22/700 vs 20/600), body (15 vs 16px), the green eyebrow pill, and header spacing.

findings.title: Page is 7-8x taller than the frame: the real legal draft replaced Figma's placeholder prose
findings.figma: Placeholder legal prose, 1772px tall (node 504:124): intro paragraph plus eight short numbered sections, one paragraph each. MARKETING-SITE-HANDOFF section 1a/8 labels it 'placeholder - not legal advice; a real legal pass is required before launch'.
findings.build: 13407px tall: the real Privacy Policy rendered from src/lib/legal/privacy.generated.ts (generated from docs/legal/PRIVACY-POLICY-PLATFORM-DRAFT.md by scripts/sync_legal.ts) through src/components/legal/LegalPage.vue, LegalBlocks.vue, LegalList.vue, LegalTable.vue. Paragraph-level differences are not reported.
findings.evidence: $RUN/report.json pairs privacy: build 13407px vs frame 1772px (height_delta +11635); vp_style_diff privacy: 461 build text nodes against 49 Figma text nodes, and only the navbar/footer words pair by text.
findings.source: ClickUp 17tnw2b0x3g, delivered by PR #142 (commit e7566a96): 'The old hand-written stubs (with the false claims) are replaced'; implementation/marketing/README.md 'Legal pages'; docs/legal/LEGAL-DRAFT-NOTES.md section 3; MARKETING-SITE-HANDOFF.md section 8 (Figma legal copy is Assumed placeholder).

findings.title: Title, last-updated line, section titles and clause numbering come from the document itself
findings.figma: H1 'Privacy Policy'; 'Last updated: August 2026'; intro paragraph; headings '1. Our approach' style with a single paragraph per section.
findings.build: H1 'SelahCue Privacy Policy' (the document's own '#' title); 'Version 0.3 (draft) · Last updated 1 October 2026' (the document's version line); no intro paragraph, instead a 'Summary in plain language' box; 13 sections with hanging clause numbers (1.1, 1.2, ...), nested lists, tables, bold and inline code.
findings.evidence: dom h1 'SelahCue Privacy Policy'; dom time 'Version 0.3 (draft) · Last updated 1 October 2026' 14px/400 centred #a7aebe (same treatment as Figma's 14px muted centred line); dom lb-clause / lb-num spans.
findings.source: implementation/marketing/README.md 'Legal pages': the generator renders headings, numbered clauses, lists, tables, bold, inline code and safe links, and generation fails if there is no 'Version X.Y (final, YYYY-MM-DD)' line so 'Last updated' cannot silently disappear. Treatment of the last-updated line (14px, muted, centred) matches Figma.

findings.title: Contents sidebar with scroll-spy and a skip link are build-only
findings.figma: No table of contents, no sidebar, no skip link: a single centred 780px text column (x330-1110).
findings.build: Two-column layout (LegalPage.vue .legal-layout: 260px Contents + 48px gap + 760px text). Sticky 'Contents' nav (top 88px, scrolls within itself), active entry highlighted by scroll-spy (src/lib/legal/useScrollSpy.ts), collapses to a toggle below 820px. 'Skip to the document text' link is the first focus stop after the navbar; the Contents links are the next stops, then the document's own links.
findings.evidence: dom: .toc-label 'Contents' at x184, 14 .toc-link entries, .legal-text at x492 w760; focus list: navbar, 'Skip to the document text', 'Summary in plain language', then the remaining Contents links, then the document's own links; tests/legalPage.test.ts and scripts/legal_pages_headless.py pin it. No Figma frame draws this element: recommend Uma ratifies it.
findings.source: ClickUp 17tnw2b0x3g, delivered by PR #142 (commit e7566a96): 'Contents sidebar with scroll-spy (stacks and collapses below 820px), numbered sections with deep-linkable anchors that clear the sticky navbar, summary box, accessible scrollable tables, skip link.' Also implementation/marketing/README.md 'Legal pages'.

findings.title: Draft banner, 'Key details' box and 'Summary in plain language' box are build-only
findings.figma: None of these are drawn. Header goes straight from the last-updated line to the intro paragraph.
findings.build: Amber 'Draft, pending legal review' banner (1072 wide, radius 12, left border 4px) with the document's own notes and highlighted {{PLACEHOLDER}} chips; a bordered 'Key details' list (entity, address, registration number, contacts, effective date); the 'Summary in plain language' box. Together they push the first section to y1581 (first section heading).
findings.evidence: dom: .draft-banner h167.4 (y308), .legal-facts h191.5 (y507), .summary-box h802.5 (y739). src/components/legal/LegalPage.vue (state.draft, doc.facts, doc.summary); src/lib/legal/document.ts legalPageState.
findings.source: docs/legal/LEGAL-DRAFT-NOTES.md section 3 and implementation/marketing/README.md 'Legal pages': a page shows the draft banner, highlights placeholders and sends noindex while any placeholder remains, the DRAFT banner is still in the markdown, or the version status is not exactly 'final' (fails closed; PR #142 commit 'draft treatment fails closed', 17tnw2b0x3g).

findings.title: Page title size, weight and leading
findings.figma: H1 'Privacy Policy' 44px/700, line-height 50, centred, #eef1f6, 16px above the last-updated line (y218, h50).
findings.build: src/components/legal/LegalPage.vue .legal-title: 36px/800, line-height 1.15 (41.4px), margin 16px 0 8px, overflow-wrap anywhere.
findings.evidence: dom legal-title fs 36px fw 800 lh 41.4px; figma-style/privacy.json text 'Privacy Policy' fs 44 fw 700 lh 50.
findings.fix: LegalPage.vue .legal-title: font-size 44px; font-weight 700; line-height 50px; margin 16px 0 16px (title to version gap 16). Keep the existing 30px mobile size (out of scope).

findings.title: Eyebrow pill: wrong variant and label
findings.figma: Pill 'LEGAL' (node 504:140, 68x27): 12px/700, tracking 1.2, #5b6bd6 on #1e232c, padding 6/12.

findings.title: Header block spacing and divider
findings.figma: Hero 504:139 / 504:218: 96px above the pill, pill-to-title 16, title-to-updated 16; no rule under the header; the first text starts 40px below the last-updated line.

findings.evidence: dom legal-header y129 h146.9 border-bottom; dom ui-badge y130 (navbar bottom 69); figma-style pill y175 under a nav that ends at 79; title y218, last-updated y284 (gap 16 vs build 9.6).
findings.fix: Raise .legal-page top padding to 96px; set the title/version gap to 16px; remove the .legal-header bottom border (or confirm with Uma that the divider is wanted).

findings.title: Section heading scale and numbering ink
findings.figma: Section heading ('1. Our approach' style): ONE text run 20px/600, line-height 26, #eef1f6 (number and title the same ink); 10px to its paragraph; 28px between sections.

findings.fix: LegalPage.vue .sec-h2: font-size 20px; font-weight 600; line-height 26px; margin 28px 0 10px; .sec-num inherits the heading ink. Hanging clause numbers (1.1, 1.2) in the body stay (B, privacy-02).

findings.title: Body type scale and text measure
findings.figma: Body 16px/400, line-height 26, #9aa4b2; intro paragraph 17px/27; text column 780 wide at x330 (centred); Figma draws one paragraph per section, so paragraph-to-paragraph spacing, lists inside clauses and tables are not drawn.
findings.build: LegalBlocks.vue .lb-p and LegalList.vue .ll-item: 15px, line-height 1.7 (25.5px), --sc-text-secondary (#a7aebe, a mapped colour: B); paragraph margin-bottom 16px; text column .legal-text max-width 760px at x492 (the Contents column takes x184-440).
findings.evidence: dom lb-p fs 15px lh 25.5px; legal-text w 760 x 492; figma-style/privacy.json body nodes fs 16 lh 26 w 780 x 330.
findings.fix: Body 16px / 26px in LegalBlocks.vue and LegalList.vue; .legal-text max-width 780px; keep 16px paragraph spacing inside multi-paragraph sections (undrawn, so it is a designer call, not a mismatch).

findings.title: Inline link colour is --sc-primary-hover with an underline
findings.figma: No inline links are drawn on this frame (other frames use primary #5b6bd6, 4.07:1 on #0e1116).
findings.build: LegalInline.vue .li-link: #7e6eff (--sc-primary-hover), underlined, 3px offset; hover turns to --sc-text.
findings.evidence: dom li-link color rgb(126,110,255). Measured: --sc-primary #6e5cf0 on #0b0d12 = 4.12:1 (fails AA 4.5:1); #7e6eff on #0b0d12 = 5.15:1.
findings.source: Measurement: --sc-primary 4.12:1 on the page base fails AA for 15px text; the build keeps an accessible ink at 5.15:1. Flag for Uma: the 'links in --sc-primary' rule in MARKETING-PORTAL-GAP-FILL-HANDOFF.md line 193 cannot be met on this background without this lighter token.

findings.title: Figma privacy mailbox and date are not backed

findings.title: Programme terms, payout methods and promises are invented
findings.figma: '12 months' (renewals), '60 days' cookie/attribution, 'Monthly' payouts, 'Free to join · No audience minimum · Monthly payouts via PayPal, Wise or bank', 'pass $50', 'Most applications are reviewed within a couple of days', 'ready-made banners', 'Banners, links and email copy are done for you', FAQ 'no cap'.

findings.evidence: No attribution window, threshold, payout rail or review-time exists in docs/ or implementation/ (grep above); the platform's payment provider in the legal draft is Paystack, not PayPal or Wise; affiliate resources and payouts views are mock data (README 'Known gaps'). docs/product/prds/SelahCue-Platform-PRD.md line 51 (NG-P1: affiliate programme NOT-V1, ClickUp 86ak11w7g) and docs/decisions/DECISION-LOG.md line 287 (DEC-008: 'affiliate terms' still open).
findings.decision: Owner: none of these figures or promises can ship until the affiliate terms exist (DEC-008). Remove or replace with honest placeholders when 17tnw2b0x3h lands; affiliates-07, 03 and 08 keep Figma's layout around whatever copy remains.

findings.title: Checklist claims: one backed, one unbacked, two depend on the programme
findings.figma: 'A product churches actually keep using - it never blanks the screen'; 'Offline-first reliability that sells itself, no internet required'; 'Recurring commission for a year, not a one-time bounty'; 'Banners, links and email copy are done for you'.
findings.build: Not built (affiliates-03).
findings.evidence: 'never blanks the screen' is backed by NFR-024 (selahcue-engine tests 'a fault must never blank the live output'); 'no internet required' is backed by the offline-first, desktop-authoritative architecture; 'keep using' is a retention claim with no data in the repo (pre-release, no downloads); the last two depend on the affiliate terms and assets that do not exist.
findings.decision: Owner: keep the two backed lines, drop 'actually keep using' and the two programme lines until they are true.
